conditions.local_tax_base: local taxes (property, land, single) as share of the tax base 2021
conditions.property_tax: property and land payments per resident 2021
conditions.single_tax: single tax per resident 2021 (sole proprietors, farms)
conditions.payroll_pit: civilian PIT per resident 2021 (booked at employers)
conditions.culture: culture and arts spending per resident 2021
conditions.balance: three-sphere balance 2021 (small distance from the national centre)
